meta.title: Next round offer moves by the tick size when no vendor accepts
gaps: Create or identify a live Dutch auction with a starting price, tick size, and End Price.
Let a Dutch auction round pass without acceptance and advance to the next round.
Read the next round's offer and verify it differs from the previous offer by exactly the tick size until the End Price is reached.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Create or identify a live Dutch auction with a starting price, tick size, and End Price.; Let a Dutch auction round pass without acceptance and advance to the next round.; Read the next round's offer and verify it differs from the previous offer by exactly the tick size until the End Price is reached.

steps.note: Open the closest available existing live event; the catalog has no Dutch-auction-specific navigation or setup.
